sentences.text: This second application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.340/2022, registered at Police Station Ladnoon, District Nagaur, for offences under Sections 498A, 304B IPC.

The first bail application of the petitioner was dismissed by this Court vide order dated 29.05.2023 granting liberty to the petitioner to file a fresh bail application after the statements of Karan and Omi are recorded.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the statements of Karan and Omi have already been recorded before the competent criminal court on 03.08.2023 as P.W.-1 and P.W.-2.
Learned counsel submitted that both the witnesses in their court statements have not supported the prosecution story and turned [2023:RJ-JD:30009] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-10476/2023] hostile.

Learned counsel submitted that in view of the fact that the above named star witnesses in their court statements have not supported the prosecution story and turned hostile, the chances of the Bulji @ Gajraj vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jd:30009) on 15 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173795435/
1 petitioner getting convicted in the present case are very bleak.

entities.text: Bulji @ Gajraj vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jd:30009)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, so also the fact that above named star witnesses in their court statements have not supported the prosecution story and turned hostile, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the second bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Bulji @ Gajraj S/o Shri Babu Lal arrested in connection with F.I.R.
No.340/2022, registered at Police Station Ladnoon, District Nagaur, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 9-Prashant/-
